description_en: Queries the information about all member accounts in the WAF multi-account management feature
description_zh: 多账号统一管理中，查询WAF所有成员账号信息
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-member-accounts --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMemberAccounts

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The status of the member accounts to query. You can set this parameter to query member accounts in a specific status. Valid values:

enabled: The member account is managed.

disabled: The member account is not managed.

disabling: The member account is being removed
parameters.help_zh:
要查询指定状态的成员账号。您可以设置该参数，查询某个状态的成员账号。

enabled：表示成员账号为已纳管状态。

disabled：表示成员账号为未纳管状态。

disabling：表示成员账号为删除中状态
parameters.name: account_status

AccountInfos.description_en: The information about the member accounts
AccountInfos.description_zh: 查询到的成员账号信息

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the member accounts

AccountName.description_en: The name of the member accounts

AccountStatus.description_en:
The status of the member accounts. Valid values:

enabled: The member accounts is managed.

disabled: The member accounts is not managed.

disabling: The member accounts is being deleted
AccountStatus.description_zh:
成员账号的状态。

enabled：表示成员账号为已纳管状态。

disabled：表示成员账号为未纳管状态。

disabling：表示成员账号为删除中状态

Description.description_en: The description of the member accounts

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the member accounts was added
